narrative.overview: The site reads like a well-typeset professional letter from an engineer: white paper, one sans voice, thin rules, small mono annotations, and a single drafting-pen teal that marks where you are or what you chose. Every page sits on one grid and one vertical (header name, page title, footer). The home has a landing-page rhythm: a hero sentence at its own size, a hairline field-to-office drawing, and one ink band carrying the firm prices; inner pages read like a document, section title on the left and content on the right.
keyCharacteristics: Light-only, white paper with zinc ink; the home ink band is the only dark surface.
Flat surfaces with hairline borders; shadow only on the floating header bar.
DM Sans for reading, DM Mono for metadata; no eyebrows.
Name, page titles and footer share one vertical on the sheet grid.
Teal is a marker of state and place, never a fill or a headline color.

rules.name: The Drafting Pen Rule
rules.body: Teal marks state and place ("you are here", "this is chosen", "we are 3 of 5"). It is used in small strokes, dots and borders, never as a surface; when it must be read as text it uses the darker Ink shade. If a screen has more than a few teal marks, remove some.

rules.name: The Paper Rule
rules.body: Everything that is not teal or an error is zinc on white. No second hue joins the system. Ink may be used as one surface per page at most (the home band); it is not a theme.

rules.name: The Margin Note Rule
rules.body: Anything that is metadata (dates, tech tags, step numbers, status) is set in DM Mono at label size in pencil. Anything that is meaning is set in DM Sans. A mono label is never the only title of a section, and there are no eyebrows above headings.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Cards, fields, chips and buttons never carry a shadow. A surface earns a shadow only when it floats over other content.

dos: Align every page to the sheet grid: name, h1 and footer on one vertical.
Build inner pages with Page, PageIntro, Section and end them with ContactCard; take sizes from src/lib/typography.ts.
Set metadata in DM Mono at 0.75rem in pencil.
Use teal only as a stroke, dot, border or short label.
Give every interactive element a 44px target; keep the 2px ink focus outline (fields use the teal-700 border + ring).
Keep motion to the home load sequence, the menu disclosure and small hover nudges, all cut under prefers-reduced-motion.
Write template comments as {/* */} so they never ship in the HTML.
donts: Don't fill a button, card or heading with teal, or add a second accent hue.
Don't add shadows to cards, buttons, fields or chips.
Don't use a mono eyebrow above a heading or as the only title of a section.
Don't centre an inner page in a narrow column with empty space on both sides.
Don't use a component library; components are custom Tailwind.
Don't add count-ups, carousels or a motion library; no dark mode, no weight above 600.
